note: Deterministic template matrix (spec 4.5). Nothing here is generated by a language model. Guidance basis is stated per rule: these are internal heuristics and carry no external citation yet. That is shown to the user and tracked as an open item.

rules.text: Your current source region is the main concentration point for this material. Look at these other producing countries as possible alternate sources: {alternatives}. Their qualification has not been reviewed.
rules.guidance_basis: Internal heuristic (diversify away from the dominant supplier). No external citation yet.

rules.when: region_known AND NOT region_matches_dominant AND tier in (High, Critical)
rules.text: Global supply is highly concentrated even though your current source region is not the dominant one. A disruption there could still affect the wider market. Consider buffer inventory.
rules.guidance_basis: Internal heuristic (buffer stock against market-wide disruption). No external citation yet.

rules.text: The index currently indicates {tier} market-level exposure. Keep monitoring it periodically. Supplier and inventory risks specific to your company are outside this assessment.
rules.guidance_basis: Not a recommendation to act. Describes the scope of a market-level index.

rules.when: region in (Diversified, Not sure, Other regions) AND tier in (High, Critical)
rules.text: The index indicates {tier} market-level exposure for this material. Because your source region cannot be compared with the dominant supplier, no alternate-source suggestion is made.
rules.guidance_basis: Neutral row (spec 4.5): no meaningful comparison is possible.

rules.when: volume = Large AND any High/Critical row
rules.text: At your stated volume, qualifying a second high-capacity source is worth prioritizing over ad hoc buffer stock.
rules.guidance_basis: Internal heuristic (volume-scaled sourcing). No external citation yet.

rules.when: volume = Small AND any High/Critical row
rules.text: At your stated volume, a smaller-scale backup arrangement or short-term buffer may be more practical than a full alternate-source qualification process.
rules.guidance_basis: Internal heuristic (volume-scaled sourcing). No external citation yet.
